nodes.name: Normalise Records
nodes.notes: Trims every string field and turns blanks into null, so a downstream equality check does not treat '' and ' ' as different values. Drops undefined keys. Does not invent fields.

### Normalise Records

Trims strings, blanks become null, undefined keys dropped. No external calls.

Next: Stamp Post-Processing

### Stamp Post-Processing

Writes `status`, `postProcessedBy`, `postProcessedAt`.

Returns to the calling workflow.

## lib: Post-Process Records

Post-processing for records. Runs after the parent's main work, tidies the record records, and reports back. Deterministic: no credentials, no network.

**Called by:** parent templates that reference `lib: Post-Process Records` in an Execute Workflow or Workflow Tool node.

### Contract

**In:** the items the parent was holding when it called. No fields required.

**Out:** the same items, each with `status: "done"`, `postProcessedBy` and `postProcessedAt` added. The parent reads `status`; the item count is preserved so nothing downstream sees fewer rows than it sent.

### Credentials setup

**None.** This lib calls nothing external, so it runs as imported.

### Troubleshooting

**Parent reports no status.** The Execute Workflow node in the parent must have `Wait For Sub-Workflow Completion` on - it is on by default in every template that calls this - otherwise the parent continues before this returns.

**Fewer items than expected.** This lib never drops items. If the count fell, it fell upstream in the parent.
